quality_rules: Prefer official government, FAO, CGIAR/IITA, recognised African agricultural organisations, development institutions and reputable market information systems.
Never invent a grant, loan, price, deadline, supplier, news story or programme.
Never treat a generic country profile as a grant, finance or machinery opportunity.
Retain original source URL and verification date.
Expired opportunities must be flagged or removed from active listings.
Manual CMS overrides remain available but must be visibly marked.
